title: RepGen: Reproducing Deep Learning Bugs through Context-Aware Code Generation and Verification
title_zh: RepGen：通过上下文感知的代码生成与验证来复现深度学习缺陷

paragraphs.en: RepGen通过上下文感知代码生成与迭代验证自动复现深度学习缺陷，成功率达80.19%。 Reproducing deep learning (DL) bugs is challenging because failures can involve source code, models, data, dependencies, and execution environments. Incomplete bug reports further complicate reproduction by omitting essential details. We present RepGen, an open-source tool for reproducing DL bugs through context-aware code generation and iterative verification. Given a bug report and repository, RepGen explores the codebase to build a learning-enhanced context, develop a reproduction plan, and generate candidate scripts. It refines candidates using static checks and LLM feedback to improve their correctness and relevance. When enabled, the tool prepares the execution environment, runs the script, and assesses its output against the reported failure. RepGen provides an interactive command-line interface supporting local and hosted LLMs, configurable execution budgets, and inspectable artifacts, along with a GitHub Action for automated issue processing. The underlying approach reproduced 85 of 106 real-world DL bugs (80.19%). A controlled study with 27 developers showed a 23.35% improvement in reproduction success and a 56.8% reduction in reproduction time.
paragraphs.zh: 复现深度学习（DL）缺陷之所以困难，是因为故障可能涉及源代码、模型、数据、依赖项和执行环境。RepGen 通过上下文感知代码生成与迭代验证自动复现深度学习缺陷，成功率达 80.19%。 不完整的缺陷报告因缺少关键细节而进一步增加了复现难度。 我们提出了 RepGen，一个通过上下文感知代码生成与迭代验证来复现 DL 缺陷的开源工具。 给定一份缺陷报告和一个代码仓库，RepGen 会探索代码库以构建学习增强的上下文、制定复现计划并生成候选脚本。 它利用静态检查和大语言模型反馈来改进候选脚本，以提高其正确性和相关性。 在启用相应功能时，该工具会准备执行环境、运行脚本，并根据报告的故障评估脚本的输出。 RepGen 提供交互式命令行界面，支持本地和托管的大语言模型、可配置的执行预算以及可检查的产出物，并附带一个用于自动化处理 issue 的 GitHub Action。 该方法成功复现了 106 个真实世界 DL 缺陷中的 85 个（80.19%）。 一项有 27 名开发者参与的对照实验显示，复现成功率提升了 23.35%，复现时间缩短了 56.8%。
